model_card.summary: Two DPO beta variants, a format-only DPO variant, and the separate UltraFeedback excerpt SFT/DPO checkpoints.
model_card.scope: Compare relative preference margins, generated addition correctness and a fixed formatting preference without treating them as interchangeable outcomes.
limitations: Toy preference pairs contrast correct small additions with off-by-one answers; improved sequence likelihood margins do not guarantee generated factual correctness.
The format-only branch keeps the correct addition in both sides and adds a fixed redundant suffix to the rejected answer.
Sequence log probabilities sum supervised answer-token log probabilities including EOS; the reported absolute and reference-relative margins differ.
The UltraFeedback pilot uses 120-byte UTF-8-safe prompt/answer excerpts. Whole-answer preference labels may no longer apply to the cropped fragments.
All natural-data pilot models are very small and receive short training; they are not evidence of broad alignment or conversational quality.
Frozen reference snapshots and all raw preference datasets/reports are omitted from the public draft; selected native policy checkpoints are standalone.

Toy beta=0.1/beta=1.0 improve the reference-relative test margin on only 1/7 and 0/7 pairs, with mean relative margins -16.2735 and -5.0343. Both have 0.0 generated arithmetic exact match. Format-only improves relative preference on 7/7 test pairs while arithmetic exact match remains 0.0; likelihood preference is not answer correctness.

review.scope: Reviewed completed-run provenance, exact artifact hashes, final standalone policy checkpoint selection, toy task and wording/generalization limitations, and source license notices. The safety synthetic branch is independent of the private PKU pilot; DPO references/raw pairs are excluded. Release must still pass native reconstruction and anonymous pinned-file roundtrip.
